description: This file implements a cache mechanism using Qdrant vector similarity database for semantic responses. It contains a class `QdrantSemanticCache` with methods for setting and getting cache entries, both synchronously and asynchronously. The class manages the creation and configuration of Qdrant collections, handles embedding generation via external services, and performs similarity searches to retrieve cached responses based on semantic similarity.

classes.name: QdrantSemanticCache
classes.description: A specialized cache class implementing semantic caching using Qdrant vector database. It manages collection setup, embedding-based cache storage, and retrieval with similarity threshold filtering. Supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Stores a response in the Qdrant cache by generating an embedding from the concatenated message contents and adding a point with the response payload.

methods.name: get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response by embedding the message contents and searching for similar vectors in Qdrant. Returns the response if similarity exceeds the threshold.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a response in Qdrant cache, similar to `set_cache` but using async HTTP client and embedding methods.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cached response based on embedding similarity, similar to `get_cache` but using awaitables.

methods.name: _get_cache_logic(self, cached_response: Any)
methods.description: Converts cached response stored as JSON string or literal to a dictionary or original value.

methods.name: _collection_info(self)
methods.description: Returns the collection info dictionary for the Qdrant collection.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline(self, cache_list, **kwargs)
methods.description: Runs a batch of `async_set_cache` operations concurrently for multiple entries.

methods.name: __init__( self, qdrant_api_base=None, qdrant_api_key=None, collection_name=None, similarity_threshold=None, quantization_config=None, embedding_model="text-embedding-ada-002", host_type=None, )
